title: Retainer Billing Run
description: Retainer Billing Run v1.7.0 implements a governed PREPARE → REVIEW → APPROVE → EXECUTE → RECONCILE → RECOVER/SETTLE lifecycle. It prepares an exact deterministic billing plan after validation and Stripe history dedup, computes a project billing_run_id and plan hash, emits a human-readable review with explainable anomaly rules, calculates a configurable approval tier, and executes only the prepared candidates. Station remains the authority for native approval, quorum, receipts, and watermark state; the workflow does not fabricate approval evidence or replace Station run_id. Partial-failure recovery is defined by a project-owned reference harness and provider-truth reconciliation. Demo: https://youtu.be/RpGMJgPzEcw contest:2026Q3
desc: Governed monthly billing lifecycle with exact plan review, configurable risk tiers, provider-truth recovery, and Station-owned approval/watermark boundaries.

def rotr(value, shift):
    return ((value >> shift) | (value << (32 - shift))) & 4294967295
def hex_byte(value):
    digits = "0123456789abcdef"
    return digits[(value >> 4) & 15] + digits[value & 15]
def sha256(text):
    data = []
    for character in text:
        value = ord(character)
        if value < 128:
            data.append(value)
        elif value < 2048:
            data.append(192 | (value >> 6))
            data.append(128 | (value & 63))
        elif value < 65536:
            data.append(224 | (value >> 12))
            data.append(128 | ((value >> 6) & 63))
            data.append(128 | (value & 63))
        else:
            data.append(240 | (value >> 18))
            data.append(128 | ((value >> 12) & 63))
            data.append(128 | ((value >> 6) & 63))
            data.append(128 | (value & 63))
    bit_length = len(data) * 8
    data.append(128)
    while len(data) % 64 != 56:
        data.append(0)
    for shift in (56, 48, 40, 32, 24, 16, 8, 0):
        data.append((bit_length >> shift) & 255)
    state = [1779033703, 3144134277, 1013904242, 2773480762, 1359893119, 2600822924, 528734635, 1541459225]
    for offset in range(0, len(data), 64):
        words = []
        for index in range(16):
            position = offset + index * 4
            words.append((data[position] << 24) | (data[position + 1] << 16) | (data[position + 2] << 8) | data[position + 3])
        for index in range(16, 64):
            s0 = rotr(words[index - 15], 7) ^ rotr(words[index - 15], 18) ^ (words[index - 15] >> 3)
            s1 = rotr(words[index - 2], 17) ^ rotr(words[index - 2], 19) ^ (words[index - 2] >> 10)
            words.append((words[index - 16] + s0 + words[index - 7] + s1) & 4294967295)
        a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = state
        for index in range(64):
            s1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25)
            choose = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g)
            s0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22)
            majority = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c)
            temp1 = (h + s1 + choose + K[index] + words[index]) & 4294967295
            temp2 = (s0 + majority) & 4294967295
            h = g
            g = f
            f = e
            e = (d + temp1) & 4294967295
            d = c
            c = b
            b = a
            a = (temp1 + temp2) & 4294967295
        state = [
            (state[0] + a) & 4294967295,
            (state[1] + b) & 4294967295,
            (state[2] + c) & 4294967295,
            (state[3] + d) & 4294967295,
            (state[4] + e) & 4294967295,
            (state[5] + f) & 4294967295,
            (state[6] + g) & 4294967295,
            (state[7] + h) & 4294967295,
        ]
    digest = ""
    for word in state:
        for shift in (24, 16, 8, 0):
            digest = digest + hex_byte((word >> shift) & 255)
    return "sha256:" + digest
